claims.scientific_question: Does patch-level readout hide within-patch 4x4-cell path heterogeneity with intervention value?
claims.population: all 100 frozen Stage Y ImageNet-1k validation images, retaining correct and misclassified samples
claims.estimand: cohort median of the image-level mean across all 12 blocks of hierarchical positive deletion AUC gain over the 32-seed patch-uniform tie-control median
claims.comparison_contrast: NNS within-patch positive-score order minus patch-uniform hash-tie ensemble, with identical native-patch order
claims.ci_and_multiplicity: 20,000 paired image bootstrap 95% percentile CI; Family A Holm alpha 0.05; directional greater
claims.missing_failed_na_handling: all terminal states retained; no replacement/imputation; INVALID below 90 valid paired images
claims.SUPPORTED: A1 Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and CI lower bound>0.02
claims.NOT_SUPPORTED: valid analysis with CI upper bound<=0.02
claims.INCONCLUSIVE: valid analysis not satisfying SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.INVALID: contract/reconstruction failure or fewer than 90 valid paired images
claims.allowed_wording: Within the frozen ViT-B/16, cohort, target and deletion endpoint, NNS complete-cut maps recovered intervention-relevant within-patch heterogeneity beyond a patch-uniform representation.

claims.scientific_question: Does class-logit-directed spatial support and concentration change reproducibly with depth?
claims.population: all 100 frozen Stage Y images under clean condition
claims.estimand: cohort median of per-image deep-minus-shallow log effective spatial support, each group an arithmetic mean of its four blocks
claims.comparison_contrast: deep blocks 8-11 minus shallow blocks 0-3; two-sided
claims.ci_and_multiplicity: 20,000 paired image bootstrap 95% percentile CI; Family B Holm alpha 0.05; two-sided
claims.missing_failed_na_handling: a paired image requires all eight shallow/deep aggregate maps valid; no replacement/imputation; INVALID below 90
claims.SUPPORTED: B1 Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and CI wholly outside +/-ln(1.1)
claims.INCONCLUSIVE: valid analysis not satisfying SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.INVALID: contract/reconstruction failure or fewer than 90 valid paired images
claims.allowed_wording: Class-logit-directed NNS components showed a reproducible depth contrast in spatial support in the frozen study.

claims.scientific_question: Are class-related block contributions concentrated in a few heads or distributed, and does organization change with depth?
claims.population: all 100 frozen Stage Y images under clean condition
claims.estimand: cohort medians of deep-minus-shallow effective head count, image-mean Fisher-z allocation-ablation Spearman, and top3-minus-bottom3 normalized ablation loss
claims.comparison_contrast: all 12 heads at every block; no selected head; allocation and ablation controls analyzed jointly
claims.ci_and_multiplicity: 20,000 paired image bootstrap CIs; B2 two-sided and B6/B7 directional greater; Family B Holm alpha 0.05
claims.missing_failed_na_handling: a block requires all 12 head arrays and ablations; no smaller-head analysis; no replacement/imputation; INVALID below 90 images
claims.SUPPORTED: B2, B6 and B7 all satisfy their Holm-adjusted support rules
claims.NOT_SUPPORTED: B2 is within its null band and B6/B7 upper bounds do not exceed their thresholds
claims.INCONCLUSIVE: valid mixed outcome not satisfying SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.INVALID: contract failure, incomplete 12-head blocks, or fewer than 90 valid images
claims.allowed_wording: The frozen all-head allocation and ablation controls jointly support a depth-dependent organization of class-logit-directed head contributions.
forbidden_wording: a selected best head proves the claim
a head is the unique causal responsibility
F3H single-sample atlas is cohort evidence

claims.scientific_question: How do source-patch contributions redistribute across destination patch tokens and CLS with depth?
claims.population: all 100 frozen Stage Y images under clean condition
claims.estimand: cohort median of per-image deep-minus-shallow off-diagonal absolute-mass fraction
claims.comparison_contrast: deep blocks 8-11 minus shallow blocks 0-3; two-sided
claims.ci_and_multiplicity: 20,000 paired image bootstrap 95% CI; B3 in Family B Holm alpha 0.05
claims.missing_failed_na_handling: requires all paired matrices and CLS vectors with conservation PASS; no replacement/imputation; INVALID below 90

claims.INCONCLUSIVE: valid analysis not satisfying SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.INVALID: matrix conservation failure or fewer than 90 valid images

claims.scientific_question: How do retention versus new attention and MLP updates allocate class-related contribution across depth?
claims.population: all 100 frozen Stage Y images under clean condition
claims.estimand: two separate cohort-median deep-minus-shallow contrasts: attention share at the first residual and MLP share at the second residual
claims.comparison_contrast: first residual identity versus attention, and independently second residual post-attention path versus MLP; never a three-way table
claims.ci_and_multiplicity: 20,000 paired image bootstrap CIs; B4 and B5 two-sided in Family B Holm alpha 0.05
claims.missing_failed_na_handling: each residual pair requires reconstruction PASS; no cross-pair imputation/replacement; INVALID below 90 for either required pair
claims.SUPPORTED: B4 and B5 both satisfy their Holm-adjusted two-sided support rules
claims.NOT_SUPPORTED: both B4 and B5 CIs lie wholly in [-0.05,+0.05]
claims.INCONCLUSIVE: valid mixed outcome not satisfying SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.INVALID: either allocation cut is invalid or fewer than 90 paired images
claims.allowed_wording: The two separately reconstructed residual allocations showed depth-dependent changes in the frozen class-logit study.
forbidden_wording: identity attention and MLP form one three-way share
higher attribution share means higher classification performance

claims.scientific_question: Do frozen geometric, photometric and noise conditions modulate within-patch, head, mixing and branch organization?
claims.population: fixed 20-image perturbation subset under all eight non-clean conditions plus clean
claims.target: clean predicted-class raw logit fixed across conditions
claims.estimand: four cohort medians of per-image mean absolute condition modulation for within-patch, head-share, inverse-mapped mixing and branch allocation
claims.comparison_contrast: each of eight non-clean conditions versus clean, then fixed arithmetic mean; all blocks retained
claims.ci_and_multiplicity: 20,000 paired image bootstrap CIs; C1-C4 directional greater; Family C Holm alpha 0.05
claims.missing_failed_na_handling: all nine conditions required per image; no condition/sample replacement; INVALID below 18 complete images
claims.SUPPORTED: C1-C4 all satisfy their Holm-adjusted support rules
claims.NOT_SUPPORTED: all four CI upper bounds are at or below their thresholds
claims.INCONCLUSIVE: valid mixed outcome not satisfying SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.INVALID: inverse-map/valid-mask contract failure or fewer than 18 complete images
claims.allowed_wording: The frozen perturbation panel modulated preregistered mechanism-organization endpoints in the fixed Stage Y subset.
